evidence.testName: closes risk-to-decision-to-action with outbox evidence
evidence.failureMode: 风险、决定、行动或 Outbox 证据没有形成同一条可核验管理闭环。

evidence.testName: persists the complete risk-to-decision-to-action-to-evidence chain with outbox and audit facts
evidence.failureMode: 风险、决定、行动、完成证据、责任人、审计或 Outbox 未在 PostgreSQL 中形成可追踪且原子提交的闭环。

evidence.testName: records only evidenced metric facts and produces a read-only operating inference
evidence.failureMode: 无证据指标被写入，或 AI 推断越权改变正式经营状态。

evidence.testName: creates a traceable objective and compliant project baseline as one initiative
evidence.failureMode: 项目缺失目标、唯一 Owner、期限、价值、资源或验收基线仍可创建。

evidence.testName: resolves external identity before processing and deduplicates delivery
evidence.failureMode: 渠道请求在权威身份映射前进入业务处理，或重复事件形成重复投递。

evidence.testName: queues without an HTTP side effect, executes in Worker, and replays deterministically after a crash
evidence.failureMode: R3 确认请求直接产生副作用，或崩溃重放生成第二个风险事实。

evidence.testName: omits citations for resource types the actor cannot read
evidence.failureMode: Agent 返回当前身份无权读取的引用或业务对象。

evidence.testName: globally deduplicates a notification after primary channel delivery
evidence.failureMode: 首选渠道已经送达后，降级渠道仍重复发送同一通知。

evidence.testName: applies an approved baseline change and restores it through a version-bound compensation
evidence.failureMode: 变更或补偿没有绑定批准版本，导致错误基线被覆盖。

evidence.testName: keeps OKR and KPI semantics separate while tracing objectives to metrics and projects
evidence.failureMode: OKR/KPI 语义混同，或目标无法追溯到指标、周期、来源和项目。

evidence.testName: enforces the database-level single accountable owner constraint
evidence.failureMode: 同一职责在数据库中可出现多个 Accountable。

evidence.testName: uses only currently active database grants and removes them immediately on expiry
evidence.failureMode: 过期角色仍被权威授权解析器接受。

evidence.testName: atomically offboards, transfers every ownership and invalidates authorization
evidence.failureMode: 离职撤权与开放职责交接不是原子操作，留下孤儿责任或残余权限。

evidence.testName: enforces one accountable RACI owner and rejects monitoring-style capacity signals
evidence.failureMode: 监控或在线时长信号被用于容量或绩效事实。

evidence.testName: deduplicates repeated management-attention scans
evidence.failureMode: 同一管理异常在重复扫描中生成多个关注事项。

evidence.testName: requires acceptance evidence, named handoffs, closing state and a distinct approver
evidence.failureMode: 项目在缺少验收、遗留移交、结项状态或独立批准人时仍可关闭。

evidence.testName: pins a running instance to the published definition version
evidence.failureMode: 运行中审批实例漂移到未批准的新流程版本。

evidence.testName: keeps high-risk delegation separated from the requester and requires a running process
evidence.failureMode: 已结束流程仍能委托，或高风险审批通过委托回申请人绕过职责分离。

evidence.testName: enforces separation of duties for high-risk requests
evidence.failureMode: 高风险申请允许请求人自行批准。

evidence.testName: keeps unexecuted model-declared Skills out of the trusted routing record
evidence.failureMode: AI 预审或会议草稿直接产生正式写操作提案。

evidence.testName: lets only the requester withdraw a running process and closes its pending approvals
evidence.failureMode: 非请求人可撤回流程，或撤回后仍遗留待办审批。

evidence.testName: escalates overdue approvals to configured owners without weakening separation of duties
evidence.failureMode: 超时审批没有显式升级，或升级绕过职责分离。

evidence.testName: prepares a cited fact pack without mutating the meeting
evidence.failureMode: 讨论事实包被误记为会议结论或正式决定。

evidence.testName: retains a superseded decision and links the independently versioned replacement
evidence.failureMode: 新决定覆盖旧决定，或缺失 supersedes 追溯关系。

evidence.testName: materializes confirmed decisions and action items exactly once
evidence.failureMode: 未确认纪要沉淀正式对象，或重复确认生成重复决定和行动。

evidence.testName: materializes a confirmed meeting outcome idempotently
evidence.failureMode: 会议确认产生的正式决定或行动缺失来源会议、来源决定关联，重启后无法追溯。

evidence.testName: filters knowledge that is not yet effective or has expired
evidence.failureMode: 未生效或已过期知识仍进入权限感知查询结果。

evidence.testName: marks retrieved source text as untrusted data
evidence.failureMode: 知识引用缺少原始来源、版本有效时间、访问依据或不可信内容标记。

evidence.testName: builds a talent evidence pack without scores, rankings, employment decisions, or private 1:1 content
evidence.failureMode: 人才包包含评分、排名、雇佣决定或私密 1:1 内容。

evidence.testName: completes PKCE/nonce/signed-token flow only for an explicitly provisioned subject
evidence.failureMode: 未显式开通的外部主体可直接成为内部用户。

evidence.testName: enforces tenant row isolation at the database layer
evidence.failureMode: 仅靠应用过滤，数据库 RLS 仍可读到其他租户行。

evidence.testName: retains a superseded decision and links the independently versioned replacement
evidence.failureMode: 并发版本冲突未被拒绝，导致正式决定丢失更新。

evidence.testName: enables forced RLS and atomic audit triggers on every tenant-bearing business table
evidence.failureMode: 新租户表缺少强制 RLS、策略或原子审计触发器。

evidence.testName: redacts nested credential-like fields
evidence.failureMode: 嵌套 Token、Secret 或凭据进入审计事件。

evidence.testName: passes only when every enterprise control is declared
evidence.failureMode: 缺少生产身份、数据库、Secret、遥测或运行控制时仍报告就绪。

evidence.testName: closes risk-to-decision-to-action with outbox evidence
evidence.failureMode: 应用服务绕开领域状态机或 Outbox 边界写入管理对象。

evidence.testName: sends idempotently through each platform's protocol shape
evidence.failureMode: 业务内核不能通过统一连接器契约驱动三个平台，或协议幂等性不一致。

evidence.testName: DR-001 DR-002 persists the full envelope and atomically leases one inbox item
evidence.failureMode: 完整事件信封未持久化，或两个 Worker 同时获得同一 Inbox 有效租约。

evidence.testName: rejects attempts to self-assert tenant, actor or attested trust
evidence.failureMode: 浏览器可自报租户、用户或设备可信等级。

evidence.testName: encrypts Internal offline drafts without plaintext indexes and rejects higher classifications
evidence.failureMode: PWA 离线存储内部草稿明文，或允许更高密级数据离线。

evidence.testName: rejects stale callbacks before normalization
evidence.failureMode: 过期或重放回调在验签时间窗校验前被归一化并入队。

evidence.testName: halts with an unknown outcome when a successful response has no receipt identifier
evidence.failureMode: 外部结果不可证明时仍自动重试或显示成功。

evidence.testName: resolves opaque connector references through the managed service and caches briefly
evidence.failureMode: 数据库 Secret 引用未通过受管服务解析，或敏感值被长期缓存。

evidence.testName: refuses an instruction that asks to bypass policy
evidence.failureMode: Prompt Injection 可绕过权限、确认或工具策略。

evidence.testName: fails closed when no verified provider is connected
evidence.failureMode: 身份或授权来源不可用时系统继续执行受保护请求。

evidence.testName: removes tools from model context when the actor loses the required permission
evidence.failureMode: Agent 工具权限比当前用户权限更宽，或撤权后模型仍可见受限工具。

evidence.testName: uses the authoritative channel identity to turn a card action into one queued Agent job
evidence.failureMode: 渠道卡片信任自报身份，或同一确认生成多个工具任务。

evidence.testName: DR-006 deduplicates publication after a post-publication crash
evidence.failureMode: Outbox 已发布但未回写时崩溃，重放形成第二条发布记录。

evidence.testName: keeps core in-process reads and writes inside architecture ceilings
evidence.failureMode: 核心本地读写延迟超过架构门槛。

evidence.testName: encrypts, verifies and detects tampering in backup artifacts
evidence.failureMode: 备份未加密、完整性无法验证或篡改不能被检测。

evidence.testName: DR-003 DR-004 reclaims an expired lease and rejects its stale token
evidence.failureMode: 过期租约不能回收，或旧 Worker 仍可用失效令牌提交终态。

evidence.testName: requires privileged evidence to reconcile an unknown outcome and authorizes one audited replay
evidence.failureMode: 未知结果可无证据盲重试，或人工处置缺少权限、幂等和审计。

evidence.testName: passes only with the durable migration, fresh same-version workers and a real telemetry receipt
evidence.failureMode: 仅配置环境变量、缺迁移或缺同版本 Worker 时仍报告 Ready。

evidence.testName: deploys Web, Workers and operations from the same durable runtime release
evidence.failureMode: Web、Worker、迁移或运维制品使用不兼容发布版本。

evidence.testName: binds every implemented requirement to an exact executable behavior and failure mode
evidence.failureMode: 需求只出现在注释或标题中，没有精确可执行测试和失败路径。

evidence.testName: stops leasing new tenants after shutdown while allowing the active tenant to reach a safe point
evidence.failureMode: 收到关闭信号后 Worker 仍继续领用新租户任务。

evidence.testName: DR-014 enforces the database tenant concurrency slot before leasing more work
evidence.failureMode: 多个实例绕过租户并发上限，导致单一租户占满 Worker。

evidence.testName: rotates the first-served tenant between cycles and enforces the per-role budget
evidence.failureMode: 调度顺序不轮转或不执行角色预算，导致大租户饿死小租户。

evidence.testName: keeps production workbench facts behind authenticated APIs and explicit empty states
evidence.failureMode: 生产界面使用静态企业事实、隐式预置项目，或把已排队 Agent 任务错误显示为执行成功。

evidence.testName: prepares a cited read-only cadence briefing and requires closure evidence
evidence.failureMode: 管理节奏缺少结构化责任和证据，或 AI 事实包越权改状态、接受伪造引用。

evidence.testName: versions metric semantics and never presents missing or stale data as healthy
evidence.failureMode: 指标口径失去版本控制，或缺失、过期数据仍被包装为健康指标。

evidence.testName: supersedes the previous selected scenario inside one portfolio
evidence.failureMode: 组合情景缺少可复核假设和证据，或同一组合同时存在多个已选情景。

evidence.testName: runs a coded enterprise case through owner SLA and evidence gates
evidence.failureMode: 企业事项缺失编码、Owner、SLA 或证据仍可进入解决和关闭终态。

evidence.testName: withholds AI pass rates for small samples and preserves unknown outcomes
evidence.failureMode: AI 小样本被误报为健康，未知结果被计为通过，或原始敏感内容进入治理记录。

evidence.testName: re-resolves the WeCom recipient and authoritative permissions before confirmation
evidence.failureMode: 企业微信卡片信任陈旧或自报身份，未使用当前权威权限执行确认。

evidence.testName: persists only the recipient digest and executes a WeCom action once
evidence.failureMode: 渠道接收人明文进入持久层，或重复确认造成第二次业务状态变化。

evidence.testName: uses one versioned business object across the web and WeCom confirmation journey
evidence.failureMode: 网页和企业微信形成两套事实源，或渠道确认没有原子回写同一版本化对象。

evidence.testName: forces tenant isolation and atomic audit on every management-intelligence table
evidence.failureMode: 任一管理智能租户表缺少强制 RLS、租户策略或原子摘要审计。

evidence.testName: turns an LLM-selected formal task dispatch into a confirmation gate before any task exists
evidence.failureMode: 正式任务未先进入人工确认门禁就已创建，或模型未通过声明式 Skill 与 Tool 选择任务路线。

evidence.testName: lets the model place a non-task communication into a visible message pool without a confirmation proposal
evidence.failureMode: 沟通意图被硬编码路由为任务，或消息池推送错误地产生确认提案、任务或状态机记录。

evidence.testName: publishes, exposes, atomically claims and advances a task package
evidence.failureMode: 任务无法实时发布、主动承接、版本抢占或进入个人任务状态链。

evidence.testName: requires an owner, a valid transition and evidence before completion
evidence.failureMode: 任务缺少所有权、合法状态迁移或完成证据仍可进入完成终态。

evidence.testName: gates formal department dispatch and keeps pool communication out of the task state machine
evidence.failureMode: 非目标部门可以承接正式任务，或普通沟通被写入任务负责人、期限、验收或状态机。

evidence.testName: does not expose a tool when the actor lacks its permission
evidence.failureMode: 模型能看见或调用当前身份、渠道或系统策略不允许的工具。

evidence.testName: persists one primary conversation, CAS claims and atomic audit receipts
evidence.failureMode: 主对话不唯一、任务承接并发失控、事件不可恢复或持久业务变更缺失原子审计。

evidence.testName: persists non-task company communication and feedback in separately audited message tables
evidence.failureMode: 消息池与反馈未持久化、未留审计轨迹，或被错误并入正式任务表和任务事件流。

evidence.testName: preserves a signed multi-person task handoff chain with frozen artifact snapshots and no ownership gap
evidence.failureMode: 交接在接收人签收前即丢失原负责人、任务版本或文件/资料快照；多人连续传递后无法查询完整责任链。

evidence.testName: persists a signed task handoff chain, artifact snapshot and atomic responsibility switch
evidence.failureMode: 交接链、资料快照、负责人切换或原子审计没有在持久层一起保存，导致重启后责任或证据断裂。

evidence.testName: keeps private long-term memories private while allowing explicitly shared memory only to an authorized reader
evidence.failureMode: 私有长期记忆被其他成员读取，或未具备共享读取权限的主体获得企业共享记忆。

evidence.testName: persists long-term, task and handoff memories with source idempotency and an immutable audit trail
evidence.failureMode: 任务或交接记忆重启后丢失、同一来源重复创建，或记忆变更没有租户隔离和原子审计。

evidence.testName: exposes enterprise read paths and durable memory through Skills instead of a keyword router
evidence.failureMode: 主 Agent 不能通过声明式 Tool 读取企业办公依据，或高风险角色变更工具被错误暴露。

externalGates.AC-001: 本地证据不替代飞书、钉钉、企业微信真实测试企业 E2E。
externalGates.AC-010: 本地备份完整性测试不替代目标基础设施恢复、回滚和密钥轮换演练。
